Already structure-only — keep or fold into new checker. Mechanics: regex r"(?:REQUIRED SUB-SKILL|REQUIRED BACKGROUND).*?(arc-[\w-]+)" (:14-16) scans every skills/*/SKILL.md line-by-line, extracts first arc-* token after the marker, parametrizes one test per ref (currently 17 marker lines repo-wide), asserts target dir skills/<name>/SKILL.md exists (:53-59), plus sanity floor >=3 refs (:62-66). Gap: refs to references/*.md paths (e.g. arc-auditing-spec:97) only validate the embedded skill name, not the file. Uses relative Path("skills") — cwd-dependent. No current marker references arc-requesting-review/arc-receiving-review/arc-observing, so the merges do not trip it.

New generic structure checker (D6+D7), parametrized over skills/*/SKILL.md via iterdir: (1) frontmatter parses (pyyaml already required), (2) frontmatter name == dirname, (3) description present & non-empty (name+description < 1024 chars — existing convention), (4) required sections exist per category, (5) cross-references resolve (absorb test_skill_cross_references.py), (6) referenced supporting/references/*.md files exist, (7) line budget: soft 150 / hard 250 with two-entry allowlist {arc-refining: 300, arc-finishing: 430}. Dynamic iteration means merges/renames need zero test edits.

renderSkillTestDraft() is the test-file materializer (D6 says learning.js but the template lives here; consumed via renderDraft :199-216 → learning.js:391 in materializeCandidate). Currently emits a 2-test pytest file (draft-suffix check + frontmatter/candidate-id containment). Update to emit the structure-only form — or drop the second file entirely if the generic checker covers materialized skills automatically (it iterates skills/, so it does).

skillTestName() (:274-276) and ARTIFACT_PATHS.skill (:293-303) hardwire draft/active pytest paths tests/skills/test_skill_<name>.py(.draft). Dangling-target mechanics for `eval ab` skill scope: :330 skillFile = --skill-file || scenario.target; :332-336 error 'requires --skill-file <path> or ## Target in scenario' (exit 1) when Target absent; :339 'Error: skill file not found: <path>' (exit 1) when Target dangles — this (:339, not :333) is what fires after the arc-requesting-review→arc-reviewing rename. Second scenario.target use at :370 (blind-comparator skillName). Entry points: cli.js:149 → runEvalCommand; subcommands list/run/preflight/lint/report/ab/compare/history/audit/dashboard (cli.js:19-28).

Re-baseline write path: generateBenchmark(:291) builds {generated, by_claim_type, evals{name:{scope, claim_type, grader, trials, pass_rate, avg_score, stddev, ci95, pass_at_k, pass_all_k, last_run, metrics{duration_ms,input_tokens,output_tokens}}}}, writes benchmarks/latest.json (:371) + timestamped YYYY-MM-DD.json snapshot (same-day overwrite, :373); writeRawBenchmarkData (:225-229) writes benchmarks/raw/. Invoked ONLY via `node scripts/cli.js eval report` (eval-command.js:460). Silent-omission property: scenarios with no results rows simply don't appear — no error for un-run scenarios.

Regenerate as the v5 baseline epoch (D5). Current state is inconsistent: latest.json generated 2026-07-02 (35 evals) while 2026-07-09.json (37 evals) + raw/2026-07-09.json sit UNTRACKED in git — reconcile/commit before declaring the epoch, else the baseline is ambiguous.

defaultK: scenario '## Trials' override wins; AB runs default k=5/condition (code grader) or k=10/condition (model/human grader); single runs 3/5. Cost model from 2026-07-09 metrics: per-trial 5–104s → one k=5 AB ≈ 4–20 min wall; full discipline+merged sweep ≈ 17+ scenarios, dominated by arc-evaluating's 9; expect hours of wall time, run per-skill not as one batch.

risks: Lost regression coverage: structure-only conversion deletes ~1,300 literal assertions, including the exact Iron Law sentences (arc-tdd, arc-debugging), rationalization tables, router-table prose, and worktree-safety git mechanics that D7 marks 'survives every diet' — after conversion NOTHING mechanically asserts their presence, and the eval layer only covers what has validated scenarios: arc-verifying, 8/9 arc-evaluating scenarios, and arc-researching have never produced a single benchmark row (no results dirs), and arc-finishing/arc-refining/arc-brainstorming heavyweights have partial/failing coverage. The conversion PR should land only after (or with) the re-baseline proving eval coverage of the sentences it stops asserting.

Sequencing collision: roadmap puts pytest conversion (step 7) BEFORE body diets (step 8), but 15 of 32 skills currently exceed the 250-line hard cap (max 675, arc-writing-skills) — the line-budget check must ship with a temporary allowlist of the current oversized set (burned down per diet PR) or warn-only until step 8 completes, else CI is red for the whole diet window. Permanent allowlist is exactly two entries: arc-refining 300, arc-finishing 430.

File-exists assertions silently dropped: 54 .exists() checks (arc-auditing-spec 31, arc-maintaining-obsidian 6, arc-observing 5, arc-debugging 4, arc-recalling 3, arc-writing-skills 3...) validate references/*.md and supporting files; the current cross-ref test does NOT check those paths (its regex only validates the embedded arc-* skill name). The new checker must validate referenced supporting files or broken references/ pointers rot invisibly.

Materializer split-brain: the pytest template lives in scripts/lib/learning-drafts.js:46-62, the path mapping in scripts/lib/learning.js:274-303, and Jest expectations in tests/scripts/learning.test.js — changing one without the others either breaks Jest loudly or (if only the template changes) silently keeps materializing per-skill test files into a layout that no longer has them.

Benchmark silent omission: generateBenchmark only includes scenarios with recorded results — forgetting to run a scenario during re-baseline produces no error, just a hole in the v5 epoch. Also latest.json (2026-07-02) is already stale vs the untracked 2026-07-09 snapshot; commit/reconcile first or the epoch diff is ambiguous.

Dangling Targets never fail statically: only `eval ab` at runtime errors (eval-command.js:339); `eval lint`, pytest, and CI don't check Target resolution — after the arc-reviewing rename the dispatch-fidelity scenario dangles silently until someone runs it. The DANGLING-TARGET sweep above should become a CI check.

Flaky-scenario anchoring: eval-arc-requesting-review-dispatch-fidelity (pass 0/10, A4-flaky per skill-eval-coverage.md) and eval-arc-evaluating-scenario-audit (pass 0/5) would make the merged/dieted skills look like regressions if re-baselined as-is — repair or retire before the epoch.

Aux pytest coupling to v5 changes outside WS6: test_minimal_toolkit_docs.py (literal asserts on README/docs/rules/arc-using/arc-refining prose) and test_arc_managing_sessions_eval_scenarios.py (asserts scenario Targets) will break during the name sweep/diet PRs — they are keep-files but need edit passes, don't mistake their failures for conversion bugs.
cwd dependence: half the tests use relative Path('skills/...') and pass only because npm runs pytest from repo root; the new checker should use Path(__file__).parents[2] to be cwd-proof.
notes: Key mechanics confirmed: (1) test:skills = `python3 -m pytest tests/skills/ -v` (package.json:38), pyproject.toml sets testpaths=tests; 592 tests green in 0.45s today; no conftest.py, no shared helpers — every file self-contains its frontmatter parser. (2) Cross-ref test: 17 REQUIRED SUB-SKILL/BACKGROUND markers across 10 skills; none reference the merge-pair names, so merges don't trip it. (3) The 'learning.js test-file materializer' from D6 is actually renderSkillTestDraft in scripts/lib/learning-drafts.js:46-62 (learning.js:274-303 only maps paths; learning-curator/materialize.js is instinct-only first-slice). (4) Eval side: 63 active scenarios + 4 retired; discovery non-recursive; Target parsed at eval-scenario.js:163; the dangling-target runtime error is eval-command.js:339 ('skill file not found') — :333 fires only when Target is absent entirely. Re-baseline flow = `eval ab <name>` per scenario (results → evals/results/<scenario>/<runId>/<condition>.jsonl) then `eval report` (regenerates benchmarks/latest.json + dated snapshot + raw/). defaultK (eval-stats.js:171): AB 5/condition code-graded, 10 model-graded. Cost: per-trial 5–104s observed → ~4–20 min per k=5 AB scenario; arc-evaluating (9 scenarios) dominates the sweep. Discrepancy noted for the plan author: decision record line 198 says arc-researching is 202 lines but the file is 287 (repo total 8,134 matches). arc-learning skill is currently 88 lines (pre-merge), arc-requesting/receiving-review 83/84.
